result.text:
base,
    rate:
      lines.length > 1 && base > 0 && igic != null
        ? round2((igic / base) * 100)
        : Number.isFinite(rate)
          ? rate
          : null,
    igic,
    total,
    lines,
    liquidacion: readLiquidacion(wrap),
    status: status === STATUS.PAID ? STATUS.PAID : STATUS.PENDING,
    paidDate:
      status === STATUS.PAID
        ? String((q("#f-paid-date") && q("#f-paid-date").value) || "").slice(0, 10)
        : "",
    payMethod: status === STATUS.PAID ? (q("#f-paid-method") && q("#f-paid-method").value) || "" : "",
    payAccount:
      status === STATUS.PAID
        ? String((q("#f-paid-account") && q("#f-paid-account").value) || "").trim()
        : "",
  };
}

limitations.message: The file is read as text as it is stored: nothing is run, rendered or formatted, and text a program builds or downloads while it runs isn't here.
